top_signals.title: Guggenheim Ties Weigh on Acrisure Debt, Dragging High-Yield Credit Markets
top_signals.summary: It had already been a tough 2026 for Acrisure. Part fintech, part insurance broker, the firm said in late May it would cut 11% of its workforce, or some 2,250 people, as part of a sweeping overhaul to modernize operations. Some of its bonds and loans had fallen, but still remained above levels typically deemed distressed.

top_signals.title: Inside the Dangote Family: Core Lessons from Africa's Richest Man
top_signals.summary: Aliko Dangote's daughters share the core life and leadership lessons learned from their father. They reflect on his teachings about humility, hard work, persistence, and his strong belief in the vital role of women in leadership. (Source: Bloomberg)
